content:
From the optical table, L0–L3 are four CWDM lanes of one 100GBASE-CWDM4 module (not four selectable host modes). The schema allows one value per field per mode, so each lane is one mode with its row’s wavelength triplet, shared per-lane `25.78125` Gb/s, `2.5` dBm max per lane, and `100GBASE-CWDM4` from Applications (wavelength plan matches CWDM4; the “LR4” table title is not a second parameter set).

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "CWDM4 Lane L0",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1264.5,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1277.5,
      "wavelength_center_nm": 1271.0,
      "standards_code": "100GBASE-CWDM4",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 25.78125,
      "tx_power_max_dbm": 2.5
    },
    {
      "label": "CWDM4 Lane L1",
      "wavelength_min_nm": 1284.5,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1297.5,

    },

}
```
